text.tspan: Share of students achieving minimum math proficiency by the end of
Minimum math proficiency for the end of primary education means students can demonstrate skills in number sense and
computation, basic measurement, reading, interpreting, and constructing graphs, spatial orientation, and number patterns.

tspan.tspan: UNESCO Institute for Statistics; World Bank (2026)
This data omits children who don't attend school. Learning outcomes over time should be interpreted with caution. Where data for 2024

text.tspan: is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2019 and 2023 is shown instead.
